name: First Nations
description: Stepped weaving, a star quilt, and the marks that go with them.
long_description: For Native and First Nations communities and the people who stand with them. Stepped weaving and an eight-pointed star quilt for banners, the four directions round your picture, and trophies for the red handprint, an eagle feather and the medicine wheel. Two-Spirit gets its own banner and trophy: two feathers bound at the quill, hanging over the six colours. Original work in these design traditions, never a copy of any nation's, family's or weaver's own design.
release_notes: The orca is gone; the Two-Spirit feathers now hang the right way up.
